title: Find the name and artist of the promotional card that has the most rulings
question: Find the name and artist of the promotional card that has the most rulings among all promotional cards with unknown power (power is NULL or '*') and is available in Chinese Simplified.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c.XCL_049, c.XCL_002
FROM cards c
JOIN rulings r ON c.XCL_072 = r.XCL_090
JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.XCL_072 = fd.XCL_082
WHERE c.XCL_029 = 1
  AND (c.XCL_055 IS NULL OR c.XCL_055 = '*')
  AND fd.XCL_077 = 'Chinese Simplified'
GROUP BY c.XCL_072, c.XCL_049, c.XCL_002
ORDER BY COUNT(r.XCL_087) DESC
LIMIT 1
